result.summary: Found 3 major layout issues: truncated text and partially cut-off cards that affect content visibility and readability.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' section
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant names have enough space to display fully or use text ellipsis consistently across all cards

issues.description: Third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off on the right edge
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel/grid layout to ensure all cards are fully visible or use proper overflow handling with scroll indicators

issues.description: Bottom pizza promotional card is cut off at the bottom of the visible viewport
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient bottom padding or adjust card heights so all content is visible or properly scrollable without being partially hidden
